transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the waste-disposition huddle started. We've got eighteen totes of spent solvent from the cleaning process staged in the waste area, and I need to hear the compliance and logistics reports in full before I can make the disposition decision and authorize shipment. Who's ready to walk me through the compliance review first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My laboratory review this morning reclassified the spent solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II — it's no longer routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. I haven't entered the classification into the formal waste register yet because I'm waiting for your disposition signature.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share my logistics update. I've confirmed with our licensed hazardous-waste carrier that they will accept these 18 drums only for a Friday 16:00 pickup, provided they are arranged on exactly 3 pallets and the manifest is submitted by 12:00 Friday. I haven't booked the pickup yet because the waste classification was awaiting confirmation — which Jonas has now provided.
transcript.speaker: A3
